tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Interior gradient Hölder estimate] 1. ch8:8.32\group ch08-generalized-solutions If $u\in C^{1,\alpha }(\Omega )$ is a weak solution of $Lu=g+D_if^i$ in a bounded domain, then for every $\Omega '\Subset \Omega $, \begin{equation} |u|_{1,\alpha ;\Omega '} \leq C(|u|_{0;\Omega }+|g|_{0;\Omega }+|f|_{0,\alpha ;\Omega }), \tag {8.86} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\lambda ,K,\dist (\Omega ',\partial \Omega ))$.
Proof

\sketch Apply the constant-coefficient interior estimate to (8.84). On sufficiently small balls, the Hölder oscillation of $a^{ij}$ absorbs the term containing $Du$; cover and interpolate to obtain (8.86).

□
